Venue: XT.com
Headline: ZRO · MIHAO · FLOAT · PIEVERSE · VVV Trading Carnival: Trade to Share $20,000 in Rewards!

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
🔥 Trade for lucky draws. Hold for extra chances!
The trading carnival is on! Unlock your first draw with 100 USDT in cumulative eligible spot trading volume. Complete trading and holding tasks to earn up to 20 draw chances!
🎁 Win up to 400 USDT in a single draw!
🎟️ Stack chances from spot trading, futures trading and holding tasks!
💰 $20,000 in token and voucher rewards—available while supplies last!
## ⏰ Event period: November 27, 2026, 08:00 – December 7, 2026, 08:00 (UTC)
## 📈 Campaign Tasks
Task Category | Eligible Tokens | Requirement | Additional draws | Total draws in category
Cumulative Spot Trading | ZRO · MIHAO · FLOAT | Trading volume ≥100 USDT | 1 | 1
Trading volume ≥1,000 USDT | 2 | 3
Trading volume ≥8,000 USDT | 5 | 8
Cumulative Futures Trading | PIEVERSE · ZRO · VVV | Trading volume ≥1,000 USDT | 1 | 1
Trading volume ≥8,000 USDT | 2 | 3
Trading volume ≥40,000 USDT | 6 | 9
Asset Holding | ZRO · MIHAO · FLOAT · PIEVERSE · VVV | Hold assets worth ≥200 USDT for at least 2 days | 2 | 2
Hold assets worth ≥400 USDT for at least 3 days | 1 | 3
How spins are counted: Each tier’s additional chances can be claimed once. Chances stack across tiers and task categories, for a maximum of 8 + 9 + 3 = 20 draws. The category totals shown above are cumulative, not additional chances.
## Terms and Conditions
Join first: Users must click “Join Now” on the campaign page to qualify for rewards.
Reward Distribution: Lucky-draw rewards are distributed instantly.
Task Tracking: Only eligible trading and asset-holding activity involving the designated tokens during the campaign period will count. Spot and futures trading volumes are accumulated separately and cannot be combined. Eligible accounts, asset valuation methods, and qualifying holding-duration calculations are subject to the details on the campaign page.
## Voucher Use:
- View your vouchers under “Personal Center” or “Rewards Center” → “My Vouchers.”
- XT.COM Deduction Coupons: The amount deducted equals the trading fee for each trade multiplied by the applicable deduction percentage. Learn more: XT Deduction Coupon Guide.
- Futures Trial Funds: Trial Fund vouchers must first be redeemed. The resulting funds can then be used alongside your own funds as futures margin or to offset trading losses. Applicable costs are covered proportionally by trial funds and your own funds. Trial funds cannot be withdrawn, but profits generated from trading with them can be withdrawn. Learn more: Futures Trial Fund Guide.
Fair Participation: Duplicate accounts, fake accounts, and fraudulent activity are strictly prohibited. XT.COM reserves the right to disqualify users and reclaim rewards if violations are identified.
Final Interpretation: XT.COM reserves the right of final interpretation of this campaign.
⚠️ Risk Reminder: Cryptocurrency investments carry market risk. Invest responsibly and do your own research.
